roms._split: Session 60: the per-account half of this block (knownRomIds and the 37-ROM enumeration — NFT token ids) moved to the profile's data/roms.json, which is gitignored. What remains is game-global: how the endpoint behaves, for anyone. Individual romIds in the prose below are written as <romId> for the same reason.
roms.source: user-captured DevTools request bodies (session 19 brief) + live-verified via scripts/probeRomsFactoryClaim.ts. See SPEC.md's ROM factory-claim section.
roms.endpointConfidence: CONFIRMED — user capture plus a live 200/success on a real romId (session 21).

requestShape.amount: <number, REQUIRED but does not control payout>

roms.amountFieldBehavior: IGNORED-OR-VALIDATED-NOT-HONORED — a live test sent amount:57 and the real credited delta (via GET /offchain/player/energy) was ~1.0 energy, not 57. Omitting amount entirely got HTTP 500. Do not read the captured request bodies' amount values as the real per-claim payout.
roms.cooldown: OBSERVED, NOT TIMED — a ROM re-claimed 34s after its own success returned the same empty-error HTTP 500 seen on an already-drained ROM. Lower bound >34s, upper bound unknown. HTTP 500 is the observed shape of 'nothing new accrued since last claim' (session 21: two ROMs claimed one session earlier both 500'd) — consistent with per-ROM accrual, not a broken ROM.
roms.landsInSharedPoolConfidence: CONFIRMED — GET /offchain/player/energy read before/after a successful claim, the same endpoint the dungeon/fishing guards read.
roms.playerEndpointConfidence: CONFIRMED session 22 — user-supplied URL from the ROMULATOR panel, live-verified (docIds cross-checked against the previously-known romIds).
roms.perRomYieldField: energyCollectable, from GET /roms/player, is the claimable amount per ROM and is honoured exactly: session 60's claim audit measured a snapshot total of 315 against a pool delta of +315, drift 0.
roms.automationStatus: AUTOMATED as of the energy preflight in scripts/liveRun.ts — it reads the ROM bank and claims descending only when a run would otherwise be short. Session 19's 'do not automate yet' caveat was conditional on the per-claim yield being unsized; energyCollectable sizes it, so that condition is met.
